data.summary: The staging directory contains DBT staging models, configuration files, and tests that clean, standardize, and validate raw operational data from the ODS layer.

file_insights.name: _sources.yml
file_insights.summary: Defines upstream data sources and freshness tests for the data pipeline.
file_insights.source_summary: Declares version 2 DBT source definitions under the 'ods' schema, including freshness checks.
file_insights.detailed_description: Defines the upstream operational database sources for the DBT staging layer, specifying schema, metadata, freshness constraints, and warning/error thresholds.
responsibilities: Sets metadata owners for data platform

file_insights.name: _staging.yml
file_insights.summary: Defines validity and referential tests for the staging models.
file_insights.source_summary: YAML configuration file specifying column-level data tests for models like stg_orders.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains tests and assertions for the staging models, validating column constraints like accepted values and non-null checks.
responsibilities: Validates data integrity of staging models
Enforces accepted values for order status
Ensures required fields are not null

file_insights.name: stg_customers.sql
file_insights.summary: Cleans and standardizes customer records from the raw operational source.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query selecting and cleaning customer attributes from the ods source.
file_insights.detailed_description: Cleans and transforms raw customer data from the operational data store by trimming strings and lowercasing membership tiers.
responsibilities: Selects raw customer records from the ods source

file_insights.name: stg_order_items.sql
file_insights.summary: Extracts and exposes order item records from the raw data source.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query selecting order item attributes from the ods source.
file_insights.detailed_description: Extracts order item details from the operational database source, preserving operational pricing and quantities.

file_insights.name: stg_orders.sql
file_insights.summary: Cleans and standardizes raw order data.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query selecting and standardizing order records from the ods source.
file_insights.detailed_description: Cleans raw order records by standardizing order status casing and extracting timestamps and identifiers.

file_insights.name: stg_products.sql
file_insights.summary: Cleans and standardizes product catalog data.
file_insights.source_summary: SQL query selecting and cleaning product attributes from the ods source.
file_insights.detailed_description: Cleans raw product records by trimming product names and standardizing category string casing.
